title: #175 - Asking Classmates To Install Computers
content:
#175 - Asking Classmates To Install Computers

Assembling computers for classmates

Brothers, please take a leave.

I have been assembling computers for classmates since this afternoon. It took almost three hours to get the motherboard done. I am working on the power supply now. I will install the fan later (physical work). After the hardware is done, I have to install the system. It will probably be past twelve o'clock when I finish. I don't have time to write tonight.

Don't wait, go to bed early.

Good night!

I love you guys, love you!
